# wallix-bastion_notification (Resource)

Provides a notification resource. Notifications send an email when one of the configured
system events occurs (disk space critical, license issues, password expired, etc.).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wallix-bastion_notification" "storage_alerts" {
  notification_name = "storage-alerts"
  description       = "Alert the ops team when storage is running low"
  enabled           = true
  type              = "email"
  destination       = "ops@example.com;oncall@example.com"
  language          = "en"
  events = [
    "disk_space_critical",
    "filesystem_full",
    "external_storage_full",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `language` (String)
- `notification_name` (String)
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `events` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Usage Notes

### `destination`

For the only currently supported `type` (`email`), this is a list of recipient email addresses
separated by `;`.

### `events`

The full set of events is always replaced on update — removing an event from this list and
applying will stop triggering the notification for that event, not merely add the others. This
relies on the Bastion API's `force=true` PUT behavior; without it, the API only ever adds new
events to the existing list and can't remove any (confirmed empirically against a live Bastion).

## Import

Notification can be imported using its `notification_name`, e.g.

```shell
terraform import wallix-bastion_notification.storage_alerts storage-alerts
```
